import random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import numpy as np
import te.algorithms.sub_algorithms.active_set as aset
import te.algorithms.formulations.path_based.distributed.worker as W
from numerics import random_problem

orig = aset.active_set_qp
stats = {'n':0,'iters':[],'failed':0}
def wrapped(H,g,A,b,free0=None,max_iterations=None):
    sol = orig(H,g,A,b,free0,max_iterations)
    stats['n']+=1; stats['iters'].append(sol.iterations)
    if sol.status!='optimal': stats['failed']+=1
    return sol
W.active_set_qp = wrapped
rng = random.Random(999)
worst=0; worst_case=None; fallback=0
for trial in range(1500):
    provider, caps, demands, owned, bias, mode, rho = random_problem(rng, trial%2==1)
    solver = W.DenseSolver(provider, owned)
    solver.configure(caps,[demands[k] for k in owned],None,bias,mode,rho,owned)
    solver.update()
    if solver.status=='optimal':
        if solver.score > worst:
            worst = solver.score; worst_case=(mode,rho,caps,demands,owned,list(bias))
        if solver.score > 0.25: fallback+=1
print('solves',stats['n'],'failed',stats['failed'],'max iters',max(stats['iters']),'mean %.2f'%(sum(stats['iters'])/len(stats['iters'])))
print('fallback triggers', fallback, 'worst score', worst)
print('worst case', worst_case)
PYEOF
